mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 72 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Badger Ridge Middle School. Please be aware that the air quality index is 53, and we are currently in the third quarter moon phase.

In city news, a 34-year-old Madison resident was arrested this past Friday for an incident involving a school staff member reported on August 30. Also, please note that phase two of the road construction on Highway M begins the week of September 7, which will shift traffic into the eastbound lanes for the next few weeks.

There is plenty happening around town today, including the Dane County Farmers Market, as well as live music at Baileys Run, Paddys Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia on Monday and Tuesday, or visit the Verona Downtown Farmers Market on Tuesday.
The Verona Police Department arrested 34-year-old Halla Nelson this past Friday in connection to a sexual assault case involving a school staff member that was reported on August 30.
Today's flavor is Mint Cookie, and you can grab a scoop when the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM.
